test_case_name: Accept all cookies via banner button

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted

test_case_name: Accept all cookies via main cookie button

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies
And then check that all cookies are accepted and the cookie banner is dismissed

test_case_name: Access cookie options from banner

intents.intent: Click the 'Più opzioni' link to go to the cookie options page
And then check that the cookie options page is displayed

test_case_name: Access cookie options from desktop banner

intents.intent: Click the 'Più opzioni' link to go to the cookie options page (desktop)
And then check that the cookie options page is displayed

test_case_name: Accept all cookies via desktop cookie button

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies (desktop)
And then check that all cookies are accepted and the cookie banner is dismissed

intents.intent: Click the 'Accesso clienti' button to open the login panel

test_case_name: Perform desktop search with query

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click the button with class 'btn-search' to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed for the entered query

test_case_name: Reset desktop search input

intents.intent: Click the button with class 'btn-reset-search' to reset the search input
And then check that the search input field is cleared

test_case_name: Perform mobile search with query

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cerca' input field
Click the button with class 'btn-search' to submit the mobile search
And then check that the search results are displayed for the entered query

test_case_name: Login as guest with remember me option

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field
Type $name into the 'Password' input field
Click the 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox to enable remember me
Click the 'ENTRA' button to submit the login form
And then check that the user is logged in and the session is remembered

test_case_name: Login as guest without remember me option

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field
Type $name into the 'Password' input field
Click the 'ENTRA' button to submit the login form
And then check that the user is logged in without the session being remembered
